title: docs(adr-0090): D5 — removing a row one owns is not a delete bit (#33010 ruling)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_

## Summary

Docs-only companion to #33322 (Fixes #33010). The maintainer's ruling on #33010 (comment 6879388034) says a member may delete an attachment they uploaded themselves, own uploads only, and that the ADR-0090 D5 text saying the member grant has no delete bit gets a matching sentence. This adds that sentence as a D5 bullet: removing a row one owns is served by an own-row delete door, not by `allowDelete` on a set bound to `everyone`; the attachment member grant stays read and create only.

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md`: one new bullet in D5, after the D7 lint bullet.

## Landing

Governed surface (`docs/adr/**`): lands through the seat after #33322 merges, so the ADR never names a door main does not have.

No code, no changeset.
